newsitem.title: CHINA: China's 36th local bank opens in Guizhou.
newsitem.headline: China's 36th local bank opens in Guizhou.

text.p: The Guiyang City Cooperative Bank has opened in the southwestern province of Guizhou, becoming China's 36th local bank, the Xinhua news agency said.
The People's Bank of China, or central bank, has approved the opening of the Guiyang City Cooperative Bank, Xinhua said in a report on Friday.
The bank, which opened for business on Friday, has capital of 200 million yuan ($24.1 million), the agency said. Stockholders include the local government, domestic enterprises and residents.
China set up its first local bank in Shenzhen in 1995, the agency said.
